params.message:
Add an OpenAPI reference for the public and partner API

Two OpenAPI 3.1 documents written from the code, a reference page per
API under /docs drawn by a self-hosted Scalar build, the raw documents
for download, and tests that hold the documents to the routes and to
real responses. The schema check found three 500s in the partner API
and the redirect on an error without Accept; all fixed here.

Closes #1153
